# Security Policy

Do not report a vulnerability in a public Issue, pull request, or Discussion.
Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ryan-minato/skills/security/advisories/new)
so the maintainer can investigate without disclosing the vulnerability
publicly.

Include the affected Skill or repository component, the unsafe behavior, a
minimal reproduction, the expected safe behavior, and any known downstream
impact. Do not include real credentials or private user data in the report.

This repository publishes from its default branch and does not maintain
separate supported release branches. Reports should identify the affected
commit when possible.
